page.overview:
Who is Legendary Super Saiyan 2?

Legendary Super Saiyan 2 is an enhanced transformation beyond the original Legendary Super Saiyan transformation.

This form has only ever been referred to as サイヤ|Sūpā Saiya-jin Tsū}} in all media.

Broly's Super Saiyan 2 form appears almost identical to Legendary Super Saiyan form, however, it has a slight difference in that the hair in this form is completely spiked.

Supplementary material for the anime version of Kale often refers to her Legendary Super Saiyan form and its controlled state as being her Super Saiyan 2 form in relation to her standard Super Saiyan form.
